title: Network Solutions Review 2026: Plans, Prices and Speed Test
excerpt: Network Solutions is easy to start with, but it was slower than most rivals in a three-week test, and renewal costs about three times the promo price. Here is the full picture.

meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Network Solutions hosting review for 2026: plan prices and renewals, a three-week HostingAdvice speed test, support, AI builder, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Network Solutions is easy for beginners and slower than most rivals. Renewal is about three times the promo price on Starter.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Network Solutions good for hosting? | It is easy for beginners. HostingAdvice found speed a bit below average and no CDN.
How much does Network Solutions hosting cost? | Starter is $2.99 a month at the promo price and $8.83 a month at renewal.
How fast is Network Solutions? | HostingAdvice measured grade B on the cheap plan, grade C on the WordPress plan and grade A on the eCommerce plan.
Does Network Solutions have a money-back guarantee? | We did not find one on the hosting page.
Does Network Solutions have a Black Friday deal? | Its blog lists SITEWIDE30 for 30% off an AI All-Access Pack from 23 November to 7 December 2026. It is not a hosting discount.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Starter is $2.99 a month promo and $8.83 at renewal.
HostingAdvice measured grades B, C and A across three plans.
There is no CDN or NVMe storage, per HostingAdvice.
SITEWIDE30 is not a hosting discount.
